profile: Multi-tenant conductive EV charging management with CPO/eMSP commerce, public/ad hoc, workplace/fleet, home reimbursement, roaming and energy orchestration.
inScope: All 20 declared actor journeys and their lifecycle/exception treatment
Canonical asset, session, commercial, financial, energy and governance data contracts
Model-level acceptance scenarios, correction lineage and lifecycle policies

runtimeBoundaries.obligation: Wire protocol conformance, negotiated-version mapping and real charger behavior.
Authorized financial execution, tax applicability, pricing-engine arithmetic across all tariff policies, bank/PSP reconciliation and fiscal certification.
Isolation enforced in storage/query/API, secret custody, signature verification and event atomicity.
Safe physical control, grid connection permission, electrical compliance and closed-loop measurement.
Legal eligibility assessment, actual deletion/portability, verified identity and scoped retention.
Accessible and comprehensible discovery, disclosures, payment and support interfaces.
Measured durability, restoration, performance, high availability and complete authorized snapshots.

outOfScope.area: Civil works engineering and vehicle/BMS design
outOfScope.reason: Represented through equipment, commissioning and capability/evidence contracts; this is a CPMS ontology, not engineering CAD or an ECU implementation.

outOfScope.area: Hydrogen fueling and battery-swap inventory operations
outOfScope.reason: Different physical product domains; protocol capabilities can declare them unsupported without silently treating them as conductive charging.

claim: Every declared requirement has traceable semantic contracts and executable model-level evidence. This finite review is not proof of all future market requirements or an implemented/certified production service.
